summary: Reads the object pointer stored in this+0x0, then performs two sequential virtual calls through that object's vtable. First call: vtable entry at byte offset 0x74 (vtable+116), invoked with no extra arguments. Second call: vtable entry at byte offset 0x9C (vtable+156), invoked with two zero arguments. Returns the constant 1. The callees are indirect (virtual) so no static callee targets exist. Called by NetCommSessionMessageDispatcher (0045D890) and ShortComputation_3140 (00463140).

local_names.this: pointer slot at this+0x0 holding the target object pointer
local_names.obj: target object whose vtable is dereferenced

operations.description: Loads the target object pointer from the pointer slot this+0x0
First virtual dispatch: reads the object vtable pointer at obj+0x0 and calls the entry at vtable byte offset 0x74 (vtable+116) with no extra arguments
Second virtual dispatch: calls the vtable entry at byte offset 0x9C (vtable+156) on the same object with two zero arguments

unresolved: Both called methods are indirect virtual entries; their concrete identities and callees are unknown without the target object's vtable layout
The owner object type is unresolved (UnknownObject), so the two dispatched methods cannot be named
